integrity: The mathematical proof is included and the standalone finite checker is reproducible. Classical rational-canonical classification and cyclic-matrix counts are cited rather than claimed as original. Priority has not been independently established.
scientific_limitations: Only even dimensions 2m, ranks m, and complementary images are treated. Similar normal forms in unavailable historical full text and alternate quiver-language representations are bibliographic risks. Finite checks provide examples, not proof in arbitrary dimension.
title: Exact algebra-generation spectra of transverse square-zero pairs
